entries.subject: Size: estimate from the JPL Horizons magnitude and an assumed albedo
entries.finding: Isonoe is drawn as a sphere of about 6.1 km diameter (radius 3.05 km), estimated from the apparent magnitude JPL Horizons gives for body 526 (22.894 on 2026-Sep-03, H = 15.2 with no phase term) and an assumed geometric albedo of 0.04. The size is not measured, and ignoring the phase term slightly understates it.
